turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: A social lead cost 10.43 EUR more than a search lead in September 2026 (1 to 30 September): cost per lead was 52.50 EUR for social and 42.07 EUR for search. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
